openingMessage: Set your house in perfect order before you criticize the world.
openingWhy: Before we critique the operator's plan at the pre-job, the honest question: is our own trailer inspected, our bottles full, our forms real? On location, the crew whose house is in order is the crew that gets listened to when it counts.
leadershipThought: When the plan breaks down, the people who trained hardest perform best. That is not an accident. Every emergency response — real or drill — is a data point. Debrief it. Get better.
